_doc: DIAGNOSTIC ground truth for the Stage 02 book-boundary crop (2026-08-19). Axis-aligned bounds of the BOOK CONTENT — the two visible facing pages, including their coloured headers and side strips — in original Stage 01 anchor pixels. Convention: the fanned block of CLOSED pages beside the spread is deliberately EXCLUDED (it carries no content to lose), and so is the photographer/room. This file grades ONE thing: whether the emitted crop clips page content, for which the bar is ZERO labelled pixels outside the crop. It is NOT a detector accuracy target — do not fit a book detector to these boxes; the load-bearing metric stays testset/gt/gutter.json. Provenance: hand-read off the full-resolution anchor at ~3.7x downscale with a 100-px x/y ruler overlay, independent of every quantity book_boundary.py computes. Append-only per testset/README.md.
_fields: x0,y0,x1,y1 = inclusive-exclusive pixel bounds; anchor names the image (under testset/) the label was read on, except de_01/de_02 which read from gitignored jobs/orient_fix_de* via tools/split_eval ANCHOR_OVERRIDE.
